# [Implementation] - [Phase 6] [Bug] The REVIEW channel can record a verdict the reviewer did not give

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #356 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

All five checks were validated **against `2a28a78` before this plan was written**: each block runs
from the worktree root without a harness error and currently fails on the assertion that names the
defect (`S1`: the none-bullet was captured; `S2`: `None required` was captured; `S3`: the CLI exited
1 and recorded `CHANGES_REQUESTED`; `S4`: the untracked section is not rendered; `S5`: the untracked
file is invisible to the dispatched prompt). `S5`'s probe measurement was verified separately to
return exactly `[".github/actionlint.yaml"]` for the live #352 shape.

Conventions these blocks follow, because the gate concatenates every fenced body into one `set -e`
script in plan order:

- every block starts with `set -eu`, re-resolves `REPO_ROOT` (never trusts the caller's cwd) and
  re-initialises its own `STATUS`;
- state-mutating blocks use the tool's **own** sandbox root `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-356-*`
  (the only place `FileStateRepository` permits a REVIEW → COMMIT write outside test mode), keep
  `HOME` overrides outside the git repo, and `rm -rf` the sandbox before the final assertion;
- no `trap … EXIT` (a later block's `trap` would overwrite it in the concatenated script);
- each block prints exactly one `PASS:` line, or a single `FAIL: …` line via `console.error`, and
  ends with `[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]` so the gate attributes a failure to the block whose label precedes
  it;
- `npm run build` must have run first (the gate's first command) — every block reads `dist/`.

**S1 — the reviewer's APPROVED verdict survives parse + the two-tier invariant**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0

node -e '
const { ReviewVerdict } = require("./dist/domain");
const { applyTwoTierInvariant } = require("./dist/application");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const block = [
  "REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED",
  "REVIEW_SUMMARY: Every acceptance criterion is met; the diff is in scope.",
  "UNFULFILLED_AC:",
  "- None in the reviewed in-repo scope (deferred to post-commit).",
  "REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:",
  "- None required."
].join("\n");
const verdict = ReviewVerdict.parse(block);
if (verdict.status !== "APPROVED") fail("status is " + verdict.status);
if (verdict.unfulfilledCriteria.length !== 0) {
  fail("the none-bullet was captured as " + JSON.stringify([...verdict.unfulfilledCriteria]));
}
if (verdict.remediationGuidance.length !== 0) {
  fail("the none-remediation was captured as " + JSON.stringify([...verdict.remediationGuidance]));
}
const outcome = applyTwoTierInvariant(verdict, null);
if (outcome.escalatedBy !== null) fail("escalatedBy is " + outcome.escalatedBy);
if (outcome.verdict.status !== "APPROVED") fail("the recorded verdict is " + outcome.verdict.status);
if (outcome.verdict.formatSelfCorrectionPayload() !== "") fail("a self-correction payload was produced");
console.log("PASS: an APPROVED verdict written with natural none-phrasing is recorded APPROVED");
' || STATUS=$?

[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S2 — every "none" phrasing collapses, and a mid-sentence criterion still blocks**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0

node -e '
const { ReviewVerdict } = require("./dist/domain");
const { applyTwoTierInvariant } = require("./dist/application");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const nonePhrasings = [
  "None",
  "None.",
  "None required",
  "None (deferred to post-commit)",
  "None in the reviewed in-repo scope (deferred to post-commit).",
  "n/a",
  "N/A",
  "nil",
  "no unfulfilled criteria"
];
const block = (bullets) => [
  "REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED",
  "REVIEW_SUMMARY: All acceptance criteria are met.",
  "UNFULFILLED_AC:",
  ...bullets,
  "REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:",
  "- None required."
].join("\n");

for (const phrase of nonePhrasings) {
  const verdict = ReviewVerdict.parse(block(["- " + phrase]));
  if (verdict.unfulfilledCriteria.length !== 0) {
    fail("bullet \"" + phrase + "\" was captured as " + JSON.stringify([...verdict.unfulfilledCriteria]));
  }
  const inline = ReviewVerdict.parse(block([]).replace("UNFULFILLED_AC:\n", "UNFULFILLED_AC: " + phrase + "\n"));
  if (inline.unfulfilledCriteria.length !== 0) {
    fail("inline \"" + phrase + "\" was captured as " + JSON.stringify([...inline.unfulfilledCriteria]));
  }
  if (applyTwoTierInvariant(verdict, null).escalatedBy !== null) {
    fail("bullet \"" + phrase + "\" still escalated the verdict");
  }
}

const realCriterion = "Test path: none of the retries are bounded";
const guarded = ReviewVerdict.parse(block(["- " + realCriterion]));
if (guarded.unfulfilledCriteria.length !== 1 || guarded.unfulfilledCriteria[0] !== realCriterion) {
  fail("a criterion that mentions \"none\" mid-sentence was dropped: " + JSON.stringify([...guarded.unfulfilledCriteria]));
}
const escalated = applyTwoTierInvariant(guarded, null);
if (escalated.escalatedBy !== "unfulfilled-criteria" || escalated.verdict.status !== "CHANGES_REQUESTED") {
  fail("the two-tier guard no longer fires for a real criterion");
}

console.log("PASS: " + nonePhrasings.length + " none-phrasings collapse; a mid-sentence criterion still blocks");
' || STATUS=$?

[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S3 — `codeloop review --verdict-file` records the reviewer's APPROVED and advances REVIEW → COMMIT**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
WORK="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-356-review"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/repo/.agyloop/tasks" "$WORK/home" "$WORK/shadow-bin"
cd "$WORK/repo"
git init -q -b main .
git -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit -q --allow-empty -m base
printf 'probe\n' > README.md
git add -A
git -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit -qm 'chore: probe init'
NOW=$(node -e 'console.log(new Date().toISOString())')
cat > .agyloop/tasks/356.json <<JSON
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "REVIEW",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 356,
  "baseBranch": "main",
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "REVIEW", "timestamp": "$NOW" }],
  "pausedAtGate": null,
  "pausedAtTimestamp": null
}
JSON
cat > "$WORK/verdict.md" <<'BLOCK'
REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED
REVIEW_SUMMARY: Every acceptance criterion is met; the diff is in scope.
UNFULFILLED_AC:
- None in the reviewed in-repo scope (deferred to post-commit).
REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:
- None required.
BLOCK
SHADOW_PATH=""
IDX=0
OLDIFS=$IFS
IFS=:
for DIR in $PATH; do
  [ -n "$DIR" ] || continue
  [ -e "$DIR/critique" ] && continue
  ln -sfn "$DIR" "$WORK/shadow-bin/d$IDX"
  SHADOW_PATH="$SHADOW_PATH${SHADOW_PATH:+:}$WORK/shadow-bin/d$IDX"
  IDX=$((IDX + 1))
done
IFS=$OLDIFS
REVIEW_EXIT=0
OUT=$(cd "$WORK/repo" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT -u XDG_DATA_HOME PATH="$SHADOW_PATH" HOME="$WORK/home" \
  node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" review --issue 356 --verdict-file "$WORK/verdict.md" 2>&1) || REVIEW_EXIT=$?
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0
REVIEW_EXIT="$REVIEW_EXIT" REVIEW_OUT="$OUT" CHECKPOINT="$WORK/repo/.agyloop/tasks/356.json" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
if (Number(process.env.REVIEW_EXIT) !== 0) {
  fail("codeloop review exited " + process.env.REVIEW_EXIT + "\n" + process.env.REVIEW_OUT);
}
if (process.env.REVIEW_OUT.includes("requested changes")) {
  fail("the reviewer APPROVED verdict was rewritten to CHANGES_REQUESTED\n" + process.env.REVIEW_OUT);
}
const checkpoint = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.CHECKPOINT, "utf8"));
if (checkpoint.currentStage !== "COMMIT") {
  fail("checkpoint is at " + checkpoint.currentStage + ", expected COMMIT");
}
const last = checkpoint.history[checkpoint.history.length - 1];
if (!last.metadata) fail("the COMMIT entry carries no review provenance");
if (last.metadata.reviewVerdict !== "APPROVED") fail("reviewVerdict is " + last.metadata.reviewVerdict);
if (last.metadata.reviewerVerdict !== "APPROVED") fail("reviewerVerdict is " + last.metadata.reviewerVerdict);
console.log("PASS: review --verdict-file recorded the reviewer APPROVED and advanced REVIEW -> COMMIT");
' || STATUS=$?
rm -rf "$WORK"

[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S4 — the prompt names every untracked path with a content command, and tracked-only prompts are unchanged**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0

node -e '
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require("./dist/application");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const q = (s) => String.fromCharCode(39) + s + String.fromCharCode(39);
const useCase = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({});
const base = { issueNumber: 356, baseBranch: "main" };

const baseline = useCase.buildReviewerTaskPrompt(Object.assign({}, base));
for (const empty of [undefined, null, []]) {
  const same = useCase.buildReviewerTaskPrompt(Object.assign({}, base, { untrackedFiles: empty }));
  if (same !== baseline) {
    fail("a tracked-only change (untrackedFiles=" + JSON.stringify(empty) + ") changed the prompt");
  }
}

const paths = [".github/actionlint.yaml", "src/newdir/", "docs/my note.md"];
const prompt = useCase.buildReviewerTaskPrompt(Object.assign({}, base, { untrackedFiles: paths }));
if (!prompt.includes("### Untracked Implementation Files")) {
  fail("the untracked section is not rendered");
}
for (const path of paths) {
  if (!prompt.includes(path)) fail("untracked path " + path + " is not named in the prompt");
}
const fileCommand = "git diff --no-index -- /dev/null " + q(".github/actionlint.yaml") + " || true";
if (!prompt.includes(fileCommand)) fail("missing content command: " + fileCommand);
const dirCommand = "git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- " + q("src/newdir/") + " | while IFS= read -r f;";
if (!prompt.includes(dirCommand)) fail("missing directory expansion command: " + dirCommand);
if (!prompt.includes("cat -- " + String.fromCharCode(34) + "$f" + String.fromCharCode(34))) {
  fail("the directory command does not print file content");
}
if (!prompt.includes("git diff --no-index -- /dev/null " + q("docs/my note.md"))) {
  fail("a path containing a space is not shell-quoted");
}
if (prompt.includes("git add") || prompt.includes("git stash")) {
  fail("the prompt names a staging command");
}

const large = ["diff --git a/src/heavy.ts b/src/heavy.ts", "--- a/src/heavy.ts", "+++ b/src/heavy.ts", "@@ -1,1 +1,1500 @@"]
  .concat(Array.from({ length: 1500 }, (_, i) => "+const line_" + i + " = " + i + ";"))
  .join("\n");
const largePrompt = useCase.buildReviewerTaskPrompt(Object.assign({}, base, { workingDiff: large, untrackedFiles: [".github/actionlint.yaml"] }));
if (!largePrompt.includes("### Untracked Implementation Files")) {
  fail("the >1,000-line branch does not render the untracked section");
}
if (!largePrompt.includes(fileCommand)) {
  fail("the >1,000-line branch does not carry the untracked content command");
}

console.log("PASS: every untracked path is named with a content command; tracked-only prompts are byte-identical");
' || STATUS=$?

[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S5 — the live `next --json` dispatch names the untracked file and stages nothing**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
WORK="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-356-dispatch"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/repo/.agyloop/tasks" "$WORK/repo/.github/workflows" "$WORK/home"
cd "$WORK/repo"
git init -q -b main .
mkdir -p .github/workflows
printf 'name: CI\n' > .github/workflows/ci.yml
printf 'probe\n' > README.md
git add -A
git -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit -qm 'chore: base with a tracked .github directory'
printf 'self-hosted-runner:\n  labels:\n    - ubuntu-26.04\n' > .github/actionlint.yaml
NOW=$(node -e 'console.log(new Date().toISOString())')
cat > .agyloop/tasks/356.json <<JSON
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "REVIEW",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 356,
  "baseBranch": "main",
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "REVIEW", "timestamp": "$NOW" }],
  "pausedAtGate": null,
  "pausedAtTimestamp": null,
  "reviewDispatchCount": 0
}
JSON
NEXT_EXIT=0
OUT=$(cd "$WORK/repo" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT -u XDG_DATA_HOME HOME="$WORK/home" \
  node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 356 --json 2>"$WORK/next.err") || NEXT_EXIT=$?
cd "$WORK/repo"
UNTRACKED=$(git status --porcelain -- .github)
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only)
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0
NEXT_EXIT="$NEXT_EXIT" NEXT_OUT="$OUT" NEXT_ERR=$(cat "$WORK/next.err") UNTRACKED="$UNTRACKED" STAGED="$STAGED" node -e '
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const q = (s) => String.fromCharCode(39) + s + String.fromCharCode(39);
if (Number(process.env.NEXT_EXIT) !== 0) {
  fail("codeloop next exited " + process.env.NEXT_EXIT + "\n" + process.env.NEXT_ERR + "\n" + process.env.NEXT_OUT);
}
let payload;
try { payload = JSON.parse(process.env.NEXT_OUT); } catch (err) { fail("next --json did not emit JSON: " + err.message); }
if (payload.role !== "reviewer") fail("the directive is for " + payload.role + ", expected reviewer");
const prompt = (payload.invocationPayload && payload.invocationPayload.Subagents && payload.invocationPayload.Subagents[0] && payload.invocationPayload.Subagents[0].Prompt) || "";
if (!prompt.includes(".github/actionlint.yaml")) {
  fail("the untracked-only implementation file is invisible to the reviewer prompt");
}
const command = "git diff --no-index -- /dev/null " + q(".github/actionlint.yaml") + " || true";
if (!prompt.includes(command)) fail("the prompt does not carry a content command for the untracked path: " + command);
if (prompt.includes("git add") || prompt.includes("git stash")) fail("the prompt names a staging command");
if (process.env.UNTRACKED.trim() !== "?? .github/actionlint.yaml") {
  fail("the dispatch changed the working tree: git status -- .github reports [" + process.env.UNTRACKED.trim() + "]");
}
if (process.env.STAGED.trim() !== "") {
  fail("the dispatch staged paths: [" + process.env.STAGED.trim() + "]");
}
console.log("PASS: the dispatched REVIEW prompt names the untracked file, and nothing was staged");
' || STATUS=$?
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
rm -rf "$WORK"

[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```
